svg.text: archon tries three sources in order and uses the first that has it
1. Already on your computer: a program on PATH whose version meets the least the entry
2. Your package manager (apt, dnf, apk or brew) offers that version: installed without
questions, as root or with sudo
3. The download named by the entry, its SHA-256 checked before it is unpacked, kept once
None works: the command stops with exit status 3 and says why each source did not
